reasons.claim: Eight consecutive monthly sales declarations are reported, all from the same provenance (Declaración mensual sintética).
Monthly sales are stable, ranging between 3,371,700 and 3,636,100 ARS with no strong trend.
All evidence is labeled SIMULADO, so figures may not reflect real operations.

questions: Can the SIMULADO declarations be corroborated with official tax filings or bank statements?
